emissions_regression.evaluation: Expanding whole-year folds; contemporaneous inputs, associative only
emissions_regression._caveat: High pooled R2 reflects state scale and accounting relationships. This is not a causal intervention model or a forecast of future emissions.

fuel_forecast_NSW.selection_metric: Earlier rolling-origin MAPE; simpler method wins near ties
fuel_forecast_NSW.interval_method: Empirical absolute error quantiles by horizon from earlier rolling windows
fuel_forecast_NSW.interval_caveat: Approximate bands from a small, changing historical sample. 6-month holdout coverage is coarse; future shocks may fall outside bands.
